title: Austin Property Lease: Six-Hour Talks, No Action
summary:
*   An emergency meeting was called to discuss the lease of real property for a municipal office complex.
*   The meeting involved a closed-door executive session focusing on this significant civic property matter.
*   Despite lasting nearly six hours, no action was taken on the municipal office complex lease.
transcript:

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the Emergency Special Called Meeting of the Council,
scheduled for 4:00 p.m. at 4:15 p.m., noting the presence of all Councilmembers.
Mayor Cooksey announced the purpose of the meeting is for an executive session pursuant to
Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated, to discuss the following matters;
and action, if any, on the matters will be taken during the public meeting after the
conclusion of the executive session: a. Lease of Real Property - Municipal Office
Complex - Section 2, Paragraph f.
No action was taken as a result of the executive session.
The meeting adjourned at 10:10 p.m.
